newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia palm oil ends down on bearish PORLA data.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia palm oil ends down on bearish PORLA data.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL
Dec (3rd pos) 1,158 rgt/tonne Sep (south) 1,185 *
Open/Hi/low 1,170/1,170/1,147 Prev close 1,205
Prev settlement 1,176 * sellers prices

PALM OIL FUTURES - Prices fell sharply at close due to the bearish PORLA Aug crop data. Morning sentiment was dampened by talk of a larger August output by MOPGC and weak Chicago soyoil futures last week. Volume was heavy on increased selling.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL - Lack of demand news also pushed down physicals which followed the futures trend.
The trader said players panicked and started to liquidate their positions in heavy volumes.

The Palm Oil Registration and Licensing Authority (PORLA), which released the crop data after the closure of the morning market, said that Malaysia's stocks at the end of August were 800,893 tonnes, up from 755,665 at end-July, and compared with private crop forecaster Ivan Wong's estimate of 775,000.
PORLA put palm oil output in August at 810,550 tonnes, up 12.21 percent from July, and August exports at 638,601 tonnes against 662,035 tonnes in July.
Morning prices were pressured by weaker Chicago soyoil futures on Friday and a 14.3 percent increase in August palm oil production reported by the Malaysian Oil Palm Growers' Council.
"We expect to see more selling if demand is seen to be lacking in the short-term," another trader said, but added that the market expects some fresh tenders.
Cargo surveyor (SGS) M Bhd said that exports for September 1-15 were 310,058 tonnes against 287,394 tonnes in August 1-15.
Volume on the futures market swelled to 4,321 lots against 3,900 lots on Friday.
"Technical selling also appeared after December futures broke the 1,150 ringgit level," a trader said.
By the close, new third position December futures closed 18 ringgit lower at 1,158 ringgit ($463.76) a tonne after trading between 1,147 and 1,170 ringgit.
Interest among physical was confined to selected products and nearby crude palm oil.

Sep (south) crude palm oil was quoted sellers at 1,185 ringgit a tonne after trading from 1,190 to 1,180, with bids at 1,175. Sep (central) was offered at 1,170 with bids at 1,155. Sep (north) saw offers at 1,160 and bids at 1,150.
Oct (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,190 ringgit with bids at 1,180. Oct (central) saw offers at 1,170 and bids at 1,155 and Nov (south) at 1,195 with bids at 1,185.
In refined products, Sep RBD palmoil was offered at $512.50 a tonne FOB Malaysia, Oct at $510 and Nov/Dec at $507.50. Dec was traded at $506.

Sep RBD palm olein saw offers at $550, Oct at $545 and Nov/Dec at $532.50, with Oct traded at $545 and $544, and Nov/Dec from $535 to $532. Sep/Oct RBD palm stearin was offered at $410 and Sep/Oct palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $340. - Tan Lee Lee (603-2308911) ($1=2.4970 ringgit)
